findings: Source deterministically attributes GERD to thoracic/costovertebral malalignment, diaphragmatic restriction, vagal compression and pressure-gradient failure, then claims SART restores these pathways and improves herbal delivery. These claims exceed the cited evidence.

DOI 10.15344/2456-3501/2016/116 was an open, single-centre, one-arm study of 22 GERD patients from one OMT practice receiving 3–12 sessions. It cannot establish causation, comparative efficacy, Bodyall SART mechanisms or neural/microcirculatory restoration.

DOI 10.1155/2017/9591319 was a systematic review/meta-analysis of 12 randomized trials of modified Banxia Xiexin Decoction. The authors report generally poor methodological quality, small samples, publication bias risk and insufficient safety reporting; it does not prove ingredient-level mechanisms or synergy with manual care.
GERD alarm symptoms to preserve: chest pain, dysphagia/odynophagia, persistent vomiting, GI bleeding and unexplained weight loss. Source for final candidate: NIDDK and 2022 ACG guideline.
image_decision: Retain only the clinical hero with 1376x768 reservation; remove the mechanism image that visually reinforces unsupported decompression-vagus-herbal-delivery causality.
